svg.title: Manus and GitHub with the Delivery System
svg.desc: Review an existing project or bootstrap a new one. Once approved, Manus implements ready tasks with tests and documented evidence. Blockers go to the owner. Review and acceptance lead to rework, further tasks, or an authorized release.

g.text: Manus + GitHub + Delivery System
Two entry levels · Direct work in Manus · Specs and tasks guide implementation
1 Load the GitHub project and instructions
Verify repository, branch, access, and connector/sync behavior
Level 1 · Existing project
Review current state; preserve completed documents.
First-time adoption: repository review + bootstrap.
Already adopted: select relevant specs / tasks.
Level 2 · New project
Step 0 not applicable; bootstrap steps 1–12.
Clarify requirements, initial spec, and tasks.
Record answers and explicit deferrals.
2 Verify readiness and plan approval
Check bootstrap, source blockers, dependencies, and checkpoints
3 Manus independently implements ready tasks
Stay within the approved plan; respect existing IDs and write boundaries
4 Run checks and document progress
Actual results, status, and criteria coverage in the existing task format
5 At agreed checkpoints: review and acceptance
Review diff and evidence; identify rework or the next part of the plan
Another
ready task
Rework /
more tasks
6 Merge and release through the existing project process
Approved revision, responsible owner, and existing pipeline
On blockers: stop dependent work, ask the owner, and record the decision.
A push is not acceptance. Explicitly clarify automatic main sync before changes.
Preview · Live verification pending · Details and feedback loops: workflow.md and howto.md
